title: UI Design Sync & Setup
transcript:
John: Let's review UI progress.
Mike: I have setup the React structure with Vite. I will build the initial components by Tuesday.
Sarah: The backend APIs for summarization are ready, but we need to implement RAG next.
John: We'll implement a file-based RAG using TF-IDF for cosine similarity to find relevant meetings. Let's aim to complete the integration by Friday.

decisions: Use file-based RAG with TF-IDF and cosine similarity

title: Meeting: finalize the Sprint 8 tasks (Jun 26, 2026)
transcript:
Meeting: Sprint Planning - Mobile App
Date: July 15, 2026

John (Project Manager):
Good morning everyone. Today's agenda is to finalize the Sprint 8 tasks and confirm the release timeline.

Sarah (Backend Developer):
The authentication APIs are completed and tested. They're ready for integration.

Mike (Frontend Developer):
The dashboard UI is about 80% complete. I need two more days to finish the remaining components.

Emily (QA Engineer):
Testing of the login flow is complete. I found two minor bugs in the dashboard that need to be fixed before release.

John:
Considering the remaining frontend work and QA fixes, I propose moving the release from July 20 to July 23.

Everyone:
Agreed.

Sarah:
I'll help Mike integrate the authentication APIs by tomorrow.

Mike:
I'll complete the dashboard UI by July 17.

Emily:
I'll start full regression testing on July 18 and submit the QA report by July 19.

John:
Great. We'll have our next status meeting on July 18.

decisions: move the release from July 20 to July 23

action_items.task: help Mike integrate the authentication APIs

title: Meeting: finalize the customer portal launch plan (Jun 26, 2026)
transcript:
Meeting: Customer Portal Launch Planning
Date: July 22, 2026
Time: 10:00 AM

David (Product Manager):
Good morning, everyone. Today's agenda is to finalize the customer portal launch plan and discuss the remaining blockers.

Lisa (UI/UX Designer):
The new dashboard designs have been approved by the stakeholders. I'll share the final Figma files after this meeting.

Kevin (Backend Developer):
The payment integration is complete. However, the notification service still needs testing.

Sophia (QA Engineer):
I've completed testing for user registration and profile management. Payment testing will begin once Kevin finishes the notification service.

David:
Considering the remaining work, I think we should postpone the launch from July 25 to July 29.

Everyone:
Agreed.

Kevin:
I'll finish the notification service by July 24.

Lisa:
I'll share the final design files today.

Sophia:
I'll begin payment testing immediately after the notification service is completed.

David:
I'll inform the client about the updated launch date this afternoon.

Meeting concluded at 10:45 AM.

title: Meeting: review the chatbot development progress (Jun 26, 2026)
transcript:
Meeting: AI Chatbot Development Review
Date: August 5, 2026
Time: 2:00 PM

Emma (Engineering Manager):
Good afternoon, everyone. Today's agenda is to review the chatbot development progress, discuss the testing plan, and finalize the beta release schedule.

Ryan (Backend Developer):
The chatbot API is complete and deployed to the staging environment.

Olivia (Frontend Developer):
The chat interface is complete, but conversation history still needs some UI improvements.

Daniel (AI Engineer):
I've improved the prompt to reduce hallucinations and increased response accuracy. However, multilingual support is still under development.

Sophia (QA Engineer):
Initial testing is complete. I found three medium-priority bugs related to chat history and API timeout.

Emma:
Since multilingual support isn't ready yet, I suggest we release the beta without it and add multilingual support in the next sprint.

Everyone:
Agreed.

Emma:
Let's move the beta release from August 8 to August 10 so QA has additional testing time.

Everyone:
Approved.

Ryan:
I'll investigate the API timeout issue and deploy a fix by Friday.

Olivia:
I'll finish the chat history improvements by August 7.

Daniel:
I'll continue working on multilingual support.

Sophia:
I'll complete regression testing after Ryan deploys the fix.

Emma:
I'll prepare the beta release announcement and inform the stakeholders before launch.

Meeting ended at 3:05 PM.

title: Meeting: review the payment module (Jun 26, 2026)
transcript:
Meeting: E-Commerce Platform Release Planning
Date: August 18, 2026
Time: 11:00 AM

Alex (Project Manager):
Good morning, everyone. Today's agenda is to review the payment module, discuss production readiness, and finalize the release schedule.

Rachel (Backend Developer):
The payment gateway integration is complete and has passed all integration tests.

Chris (Frontend Developer):
The checkout page is complete. I'm still working on improving mobile responsiveness.

Nina (DevOps Engineer):
The production infrastructure is ready. We'll perform the final deployment rehearsal tomorrow.

Kevin (QA Engineer):
Regression testing is almost complete. I've identified one critical issue related to coupon validation that needs to be fixed before release.

Alex:
Since the coupon issue is critical, I recommend postponing the production release from August 20 to August 22.

Everyone:
Agreed.

Rachel:
I'll fix the coupon validation API today.

Chris:
I'll complete the mobile responsiveness improvements by August 19.

Nina:
I'll conduct the deployment rehearsal tomorrow morning.

Kevin:
I'll verify the coupon fix once Rachel completes it.

Alex:
I'll update the release plan and notify all stakeholders this afternoon.

Meeting ended at 11:50 AM.

decisions: postpone the production release from August 20 to August 22. Reason: critical coupon validation issue
